blocks.text: Community platform that combines courses, discussions, and gamification

Skool combines community discussions, course hosting, and gamification into a single clean platform. Created by Sam Ovens, it takes an opinionated approach - every community has the same structure, and that constraint is actually a strength. There is no configuration paralysis; you set up and launch in minutes.

The gamification system drives engagement naturally. Members earn points for participating in discussions, completing courses, and helping others. Leaderboards create friendly competition and surface the most active members. For community builders, this built-in engagement mechanism reduces the constant effort required to keep discussions active.

The pricing model is flat - $99/month regardless of member count. For creators monetizing communities with subscriptions, this economics model becomes increasingly attractive as membership grows. No per-member fees means your margins improve with scale.
Discussion threads with categories, likes, and comments
Multi-module courses with video, text, and assignments
Points, levels, and leaderboards that drive engagement
Free and paid tiers with Stripe integration
Community events and live sessions scheduling
Native iOS and Android apps for members
Skool's simplicity and flat pricing make it the most practical choice for creators who want to build a paid community without spending weeks on platform configuration.
Our team can integrate Skool into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
